formal.scope: Every finite field F, every extension L/F, every general Weierstrass model: actual q-Frobenius fixes a nonsingular curve point iff it lies in the actual base-change image of a base-field point; actual torsion is preserved, and all actual r-torsion rational iff Frobeniusidentity there. Actual nonsingular F7curve y²=x³+3x+2has9points and nonfixed geometric3-torsion although3|q−1and9|#E, directly negating full3torsion fixedness. This refutes removal of the BKexclusion, not the qualified theorem/corpus node. Actual q^kiterate/extension identification, torsion rank/determinant and Weil necessity remain open.
